name: Agent Substrate
description: Split OpenClaw into an always-on gateway (presence) and a suspendable Substrate actor (cognition). Runs on the gateway: registers a 'substrate' ACP backend that routes turns to the actor and suspends it once the conversation is idle.

role.description: Which half of the split this instance runs. Only the gateway loads this plugin; the actor is stock OpenClaw.

atespace.description: Gateway role: atespace the per-conversation actors are created in.

template.description: Gateway role: default golden ActorTemplate new conversation actors derive from, by bare name (it resolves in the same atespace).

templateForAgent.description: Gateway role: optional per-persona template override, keyed by resolved agentId.

actorDomain.description: Gateway role: DNS domain actors are addressed under (atenet Host routing).

actorToken.description: Gateway role: bearer token for the actor's /v1/chat/completions API.

provisioner.description: Gateway role: how to create conversation actors. 'ateapi' = in-band gRPC (needs podcert mTLS); 'kubectl-ate' = shell out to kubectl-ate (for pods without a podcert).

kubectlAtePath.description: Gateway role: path to the kubectl-ate binary when provisioner='kubectl-ate'.

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Gateway role: seconds of inactivity before the gateway suspends a conversation's actor.

idlePollMs.description: Gateway role: how often the idle sweep runs. A suspend lands up to one poll interval after the timeout expires, so leave this well under idleTimeoutSeconds.

ateapiAddress.description: Gateway role: gRPC address of the Substrate ateapi control plane.

role.label: Role
role.help: gateway: holds the channels, routes turns to the actor, and suspends the actor when idle.

atespace.label: Atespace
atespace.help: Atespace new conversation actors are created in (gateway role only).

template.label: Actor Template
template.help: Golden ActorTemplate conversation actors derive from, by bare name (gateway role only).

actorDomain.label: Actor Domain
actorDomain.help: DNS domain actors are addressed under (gateway role only).

actorToken.label: Actor Token
actorToken.help: Auth token for the actor's HTTP API (gateway role only).

idleTimeoutSeconds.label: Idle Timeout (s)
idleTimeoutSeconds.help: How long a conversation sits with no active work before its actor is suspended.

ateapiAddress.label: ateapi Address
ateapiAddress.help: Substrate control-plane gRPC endpoint (gateway role only).
